text:
LG Brings Exceptional Radiance to Home Cinemas in the UAE with Next-Gen AI OLED evo and QNED Line-up
LG Electronics (LG) is unveiling its highly anticipated 2026 television line-up for the UAE this July, showcasing a major leap in picture processing, design, and physical scale. At the center of this year's launch are three standout OLED devices: the OLED evo G6, OLED evo C6, and OLED AI B6.
Across the entire line-up, the focus has shifted from minor spec bumps to noticeable, everyday improvements, where LG is delivering visibly brighter screens, smoother gaming, and AI features. For those looking to push the boundaries of size, LG is also rolling out the massive 115-inch QNED evo TV, offering a true cinema experience, all within the four walls of your home.
A New Brain for Your TV: The Alpha 11 AI Processor Gen3
At the heart of the 2026 line-up are the G6 and C6 models; both powered by LG's new α11 AI Processor Gen3. This proprietary silicon delivers a performance jump over last year’s processors, utilizing sophisticated deep-learning algorithms to optimize picture and sound in real time, based on what you are watching, and the ambient light in your room.
Sporting its new processor, the LG OLED evo G6 boasts improved thermal management, and proves significantly brighter than last year’s G5. This extra brilliance, paired with OLED's signature "perfect black" and infinite contrast, makes watching movies in bright daytime living rooms a dazzling experience. Gamers, too, can enjoy fluid, tear-free visuals with a lightning-fast 120Hz refresh rate at 4K, bolstered by NVIDIA G-SYNC compatibility and AMD FreeSync Premium.
The LG OLED evo C6, meanwhile, receives the biggest generational glow-up, similarly inheriting the top-tier α11 AI Processor Gen3, and by pairing this chip with next-generation Hyper Radiant Color Tech, LG has managed to push the C6 to 3.2 times the peak brightness of standard OLEDs. Gamers will also notice a major step up with a native 165Hz refresh rate in 4K, making PC and console gaming feel incredibly fluid.
Conversational AI and Worry-Free Security
LG has also completely overhauled its webOS smart platform to make interacting with your TV feel even more natural, whereby pressing the new AI Button on the Magic Remote, you are taken to a personalized AI Hub that curates your favorite apps and content. Instead of typing out long search queries letter-by-letter on a virtual keyboard, you can talk to your TV.
Powered by Google Gemini and Microsoft Copilot, the software understands natural language, to the extent you can request movie recommendations, ask complex questions about what you are watching, or control your smart home devices as if you were talking to another person. And because privacy is a major priority for connected homes, LG has integrated its LG Shield security system directly into the hardware to keep your personal data and search history safe.
LG OLED AI B6: The Sweet Spot of OLED Value
For those who want the unmatched color and contrast of OLED without paying flagship prices, the OLED AI B6 – which has seen its gaming refresh rate raised to a highly competitive 144Hz at 4K – is the smartest choice in the line-up.
It also features the exact same smart home features as the other devices in the OLED range, including the webOS platform, AI Hub, Google Gemini and Microsoft Copilot integration, and the robust LG Shield security system. It also delivers the stunning, infinite-contrast picture quality OLED is famous for, with none of the filler.
Go Big: The Massive 115-Inch QNED TV
While OLED takes care of pure picture quality, LG is additionally answering the call for sheer scale with its breathtaking 115-inch QNED TV.
By combining Quantum Dot and NanoCell color technologies with thousands of microscopic Mini-LED backlights, this television delivers vibrant, pure colors and incredibly bright highlights across a massive canvas. It’s designed for those who want a massive home theater but do not want to deal with the washed-out colors, fan noise, or dim bulbs of traditional home projectors.
The 115-inch QNED will begin arriving on shelves starting this July, with exact availability depending on local retailer shipments.
For detailed specifications, local pricing, or to find a retail store near you, visit the official LG UAE website at LG TV & Sound Bar - LG's Latest TV and Sound Bar | LG UAE.
